item.title: FBI investigating apparent hack of a key criminal justice information database, AP source says
item.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of its National Crime Information Center database. This computerized database is available to local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies and includes records on fugitives, missing persons, criminal history data, stolen property and other topics.
